# fyre_vm_details (Data Source)

Fetches detailed information about a Fyre VM. You must provide at least one identifier: vm_id, ip, or fqdn. The data source will try each non-null identifier until it successfully retrieves the VM details.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fqdn` (String) Fully Qualified Domain Name of the VM (must be in DNS). At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.
- `ip` (String) IP address of the VM. At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.
- `vm_id` (String) VM identifier (format: x-xxxxxxx). At least one of vm_id, ip, or fqdn must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `allow_floating_ip` (String) Whether floating IPs are allowed (y/n)
- `auto_patch` (String) Auto-patch status
- `comment` (String) VM comment
- `compliance` (String) Compliance status
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPUs allocated
- `created` (String) Creation timestamp
- `created_iso8601` (String) Creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format
- `description` (String) VM description
- `disable_delete` (String) Whether deletion is disabled (y/n)
- `disk_driver` (String) Disk driver type
- `domain` (String) VM domain
- `expiration` (String) VM expiration time
- `host_down` (String) Whether the host is down (y/n)
- `hostname` (String) VM hostname
- `id` (String) The identifier used to retrieve the VM (same as the successful lookup field)
- `ips` (Attributes List) List of IP addresses assigned to the VM (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))
- `location` (String) VM location
- `memory` (Number) Memory allocated in GB
- `os` (String) Operating system
- `os_disk` (Number) OS disk size in GB
- `pingable` (String) Whether the VM is pingable (y/n)
- `pingable_last_checked` (String) Last time pingable status was checked
- `platform` (String) Platform type (x, pvm, or z)
- `product_group` (String) Product group name
- `product_group_id` (Number) Product group ID
- `quota_type` (String) Quota type (product_group or quick_burn)
- `security_lock` (String) Security lock status
- `sshable` (String) Whether the VM is SSH accessible (y/n)
- `sshable_last_checked` (String) Last time SSH accessibility was checked
- `state` (String) Current state of the VM (e.g., running, stopped)
- `timezone` (String) VM timezone
- `transfer_comment` (String) Comment for VM transfer
- `user` (Attributes) VM owner information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user))

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address
- `scope` (String) IP scope
- `type` (String) IP type (public or private)


<a id="nestedatt--user"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name
- `email` (String) Email address
- `id` (Number) User ID
- `status` (String) User status
- `username` (String) Username
